input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Arizona, without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof.
input.rationale: Section 11 selects Arizona law, which is outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales), and Section 19 forces all disputes into binding arbitration under U.S. Arbitration & Mediation rules rather than a court forum. The redline substitutes New York law and exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, changing only the jurisdiction and forum words and retitling Section 19 accordingly. Arbitration here is domestic rather than seated abroad, so this is a medium deviation rather than walk-away.

proposal.summary: Move governing law from Arizona to New York and replace mandatory arbitration with exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in New York County.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We moved governing law and venue to our accepted New York position and replaced the mandatory arbitration forum with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County. Arizona law and binding arbitration fall outside our accepted list; Delaware, California or England and Wales law with the corresponding courts would be an acceptable fallback.

ops.oldText: the laws of the Arizona, without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof.
ops.newText: the laws of the State of New York, without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof.

ops.oldText: will be subject to and resolved by binding arbitration pursuant to the Arbitration Rules of U.S. Arbitration & Mediation, (www.usam.com). Any award or order rendered by the arbitrator may be confirmed as a judgment or order in any state or federal court of competent jurisdiction, which includes within the federal judicial district of the residence of the party against whom such award or order was entered.
ops.newText: will be resolved exclusively in the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York, and each party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of such courts and waives any objection to venue therein.
